title: Зафиксировать CI/supply-chain contract, immutable tool lock и capability inventory
summary: Создать единственный нормативный контракт для untrusted CI и trusted private RC, зафиксировать immutable actions/tools и снять read-only capability baseline GitHub.
why: Workflow hardening без trust-plane model переносит privilege через checkout/artifacts, а licensed GitHub features могут отсутствовать и давать ложный GREEN. `RAG:✅` в `@plan/knowledge/research-P9-design-rag.json`.

include: Event-to-trust-plane matrix; top-level deny-by-default permissions; job-level minimums; fork/untrusted-code/artifact/cache rules; full-length action SHA policy; timeout/concurrency/retention/log-redaction requirements; immutable pins/digests for Syft, OSV-Scanner, Gitleaks and GitHub actions; read-only inventory of repository visibility, default workflow permissions, branch protection, environments and security/attestation capabilities; machine-readable policy checker and baseline finding.
exclude: Workflow implementation beyond policy fixtures; changing repository/org settings; enabling paid features; secrets or OIDC grants; dependency/runtime matrices; archive/SBOM production; publication.

rules: Untrusted PR jobs receive no write token or secrets, never execute fork code under `pull_request_target`/privileged `workflow_run`, and do not feed caches/artifacts into trusted RC. Start every workflow at `permissions: {}` and grant only per-job minimum. Every third-party action reference is a reviewed full 40-hex commit SHA with human-readable version comment; CLI binaries/images are checksum/digest locked. Capability inventory distinguishes `available-enabled`, `available-disabled`, `unavailable-plan` and `unknown` with observation time/source. The checker itself never changes GitHub state and emits no token/secret values.
guidance: Parse workflow YAML structurally, including reusable-workflow calls, token persistence, event/ref guards, expression-bearing action refs and cache/artifact flows. Keep the lock file canonical and schema-versioned. Test malicious fixtures for mutable tags, implicit permissions, privileged untrusted checkout, missing timeout/concurrency, unpinned containers and credential persistence. Baseline finding may be RED before P9.2; it must enumerate every current violation without weakening policy.

validation.expect: Source acceptance condition preserved in Validation section.

deliverables: Versioned CI/supply-chain contract, immutable dependency lock, executable policy checker, security scanner configs and honest capability baseline ready for P9.2–P9.5.
